_doc: MB, PSS/RSS per app INCLUDING its FUSE stub (0 once U1 ships). 'target' = the owner's goal on a real GPU desktop, background state: per-app budgets sum to 365 PSS / 484 RSS, fleet cap 500/500; they assume U1+W1+W0+WH1+CB1a+W3b (memory.md section 4). 'xvfb' = what CI can enforce under llvmpipe: identical except Clipboard 260/335 (the Flutter engine is ~2.3x larger on llvmpipe; drop this allowance when the engine leaves the resident process, CB1b). 'open' and 'closed' caps are ratchets for the one-window case (WebKit window RSS < 500 is not reachable without a UX trade-off, section 6).
